about: Places where the Figma file disagrees with itself. The tokens follow the variables (they are what designs actually bind to); the brand team should confirm each item and fix the other side in Figma.

resolved.decision: Eyebrow is 10px (line height 16px). The Typography frames saying 12px are wrong and will be corrected in Figma.
Eyebrow colour is brand/500 (text/eyebrow). The Semantic Colours frame saying brand/600 is wrong and will be corrected in Figma.
Weights are 400–700. ExtraBold and Black are banned (typography.json).
colors.json wins. Applied as overrides in data/overrides/semantic-colors.json; #0C1927 added to the palette as neutral-light/1300. Figma variables need updating to match.
A heavy border is 2px or more; a shadow with the default 1px border is allowed.
Typography frames updated to match the variables (H5 18/24, H6 16/20, Body/MD 16/24, plus mobile line heights).
Typefaces frame updated: -2% Display, -1% Headings, 0% body.
size/eyebrow description updated to +8% (0.96px), matching the variable, text style and typography.json.
Descriptions updated: 10px floor note, radius scale 2–12px plus pill, Eyebrow style 10px.
Eyebrow is 10px at any weight; Eyebrow style and text/eyebrow descriptions updated.
Cards have borders: default container = container/primary + 1px border/container. border/primary description updated in Figma.
Mid Raised is for modals and popovers only (borders-elevation.json). Effect style and container/elevated descriptions updated in Figma.
Hover removed: the container/hover swatches were deleted from both Semantic Colours frames.

'Type Scale' and 'Responsive Type Styles' moved to a new Archive page and labelled [Archived 2026-10-09]. The typography page (Typefaces, Typography — Desktop/Mobile) is the reference. Anything on the Archive page is not a brand source.
Keep text/tertiary as #768EA7 (neutral-light/600) in Light mode. Accepted by the brand team with its 3.4:1 contrast on background/primary.
Minimum type size is 12px. Components use Role/* text styles; a Text Roles collection (Document, Newsletter, Deck) sets sizes per format. Supersedes 'eyebrow-size': the eyebrow is 12px in Document.
Cards follow the container default: container/primary, 1px border/container, radius/default, padding/container, gap/stack.
Positive and Negative cards keep a 1px border in their status colour. Replaces 'status containers have no border'.
Card, Chip and Badge use one vocabulary: Positive, Negative, Information, Neutral, Primary (no Success/Error/Brand names).

Warnings use Negative (no notice colour). Information reuses the brand blue family. Added container/info, text/info, container/info-strong, container/success-strong (green/700), container/error-strong (red/600), text/on-strong.
Buttons are squared with radius/default (2px).
Tag, Contact Pill and Button have Style = Neutral (container/inverse + text/inverse) or Brand (container/brand + text/on-brand), so they follow Light and Dark.
Components are for marketing collateral, not product UI: no hover, pressed, disabled or expanded states are defined. HTML output still keeps the browser focus ring (color.focus-visible).
Icons come from Lucide when one is asked for; no icon set is built in Figma ahead of time.
Eyebrow is 12px / 18px (size/eyebrow -> global/fz/12, line-height/eyebrow -> global/lh/18); tracking stays 0.96px, which is +8% at 12px. Supersedes eyebrow-size and eyebrow-semibold-12px.
Documents and 2-pagers are A4 portrait (794 x 1123 px at 96 dpi). Margins and section spacing use padding/section; see data/formats/document.json.

Minimum text size stays 10px, the eyebrow included (Eyebrow back to 10/16; Role/Eyebrow is 10/16 in Document mode). Body/2XS stays 10px for documents. Supersedes min-size-12-text-roles and eyebrow-12px; resolves 10px-base-styles.
Brand blue brand/500 is #1655F2. Updated on 2026-10-14 in Figma (variable, 45 unbound fills, Colours-page labels), the snapshot, tokens.json and the uploaded colors.json.
Newsletters use TASA Orbiter for headings, falling back to Inter; Inter for body. No third fallback, even in email.
Newsletters are built for Brevo: {{ unsubscribe }} link mandatory, {{ mirror }} optional, {{ contact.ATTRIBUTE }} for personalisation.
The Figma design system (served by this MCP) is the only source for every format: newsletter, deck and A4 document. No other reference material is used.
